title: 第23章 恩怨肉身炼皮第24章 晋升考核报名
content_zh:
第23章恩怨，肉身炼皮
收起体修类的崩山拳修炼方法，林浩和吴峰两人，准备悄悄去洞府修炼。
他们与屋内新突破的炼气二重俞姓师弟并不太熟，现在又没有狼妖的威胁，所以他们不准备叫上其他人。
“呵呵，林浩，吴峰，我等这天已经很久了。”
刚出木屋，在矿山上没走多久，便见和他们有过节的邹山虎，带着一群跟班走了过来，冷着声音道。
特别是邹山虎在看向林浩的时候，他更是眼中凶光一闪。
半年前，邹山虎以为可以稳稳的抢下姜胜他们那屋占领的矿区地盘，谁知林浩这个变数出现，让他的算盘落空。
所以，他一直怀恨在心，现在林浩那屋走了两个高手，他立即就迫不及待的前来报复。
“邹山虎，你想干什么，前面被我们揍得不够惨吗？”
吴峰皱了皱眉头，他与此人结怨很深，看不惯这家伙小人得志趁人之危的样子，立即不爽的道。
“现在姜胜和袁昌走了，就剩你们俩，吴峰你还敢嚣张的提以前的事，今日看我们怎么收拾你们，非打得你们跪地求饶不可。”
在邹山虎身边的一名炼气二重方脸杂役弟子面露狠色，正是半年前与林浩交过手的莫三腾，他握着拳头，就向吴峰打去。
今天邹山虎一群人和林浩他们相遇不是巧合，而是有意的，就是想打林浩和吴峰一顿，报之前抢矿区地盘失败的仇。
在杂役弟子区域打架，只要不闹得太严重，看管矿山的外门弟子一向睁一只眼，闭一只眼。
并且，他们拦住林浩两人的地方，特意选了外门弟子不在的地方。
“呼！”
炼气二重的莫三腾，一拳砸来，带起了拳风。
吴峰服用了妖丹，修为已经接近炼气二重巅峰，他反应很快，挥拳迎击。
“碰！”
两人拳头接触在一起。

莫三腾脸色猛地一变，没想到原本比他实力弱一些的吴峰，打出的拳头力量，竟然超过他一大截，一股大力袭来，他接连退了好好几步，才勉强稳住身形。
这边出现冲突，已经吸引了不少其他矿区的杂役弟子，前来看热闹，邹山虎眼中露出残忍之色，恶人先告状的大喊道：“吴峰，林浩你们两个杂种敢打人，大家一起上，教训他一顿。”
“姓邹的你卑鄙。”
林浩面色一黑，明明是他们那方先动手，吴峰不过是被动接招而已。
“哼，林浩你个贱种，早想打你了。”
半年前，邹山虎他们抢地盘失败，全因为林浩这个变数出现，所以邹山虎对四人中的林浩恨意最深。
他一跃而起，快速向林浩冲去，抬手照着林浩的脸就是一巴掌打去。
并且，和邹山虎一起的其他另外两名炼气二重的杂役弟子，也开始动手，竟然要三人围攻林浩一人。
“林师弟，他们人多，好汉不吃眼前亏，我们先走。”
吴峰上前一步，一边接应林浩，一边喊道。
“嗯，好！”
content_en:
Chapter 23 Grudges, Flesh Skin Refining
Putting away the physical training method of Bengshan Fist, Lin Hao and Wu Feng prepared to quietly go to the cave to practice.
They were not very familiar with Junior Brother Yu who had newly broken through to the second level of Qi Refining in the house, and there was no threat from the wolf monster, so they were not prepared to call anyone else.
"Haha, Lin Hao, Wu Feng, I have been waiting for this day for a long time."
As soon as they left the wooden house and walked in the mine for a short time, they saw Zou Shanhu, who had a problem with them, coming over with a group of followers and said in a cold voice.
Especially when Zou Shanhu looked at Lin Hao, his eyes flashed fiercely.
Half a year ago, Zou Shanhu thought he could securely seize the mining area occupied by Jiang Sheng and his family. Unexpectedly, a variable like Lin Hao appeared and his plan failed.
Therefore, he has always held a grudge. Now that two masters have left Lin Hao's house, he can't wait to take revenge.
"Zou Shanhu, what do you want to do? Didn't we beat you badly enough in front of you?"
Wu Feng frowned. He had a deep grudge against this person. He couldn't stand the way this guy took advantage of someone's danger, so he immediately said unhappily.
"Now that Jiang Sheng and Yuan Chang are gone, you two are the only ones left. Wu Feng, you still dare to bring up the past things arrogantly. See how we deal with you today. We will beat you to your knees and beg for mercy."
A second-level Qi Refining Level 2 square-faced handyman disciple next to Zou Shanhu had a ruthless look on his face. It was Mo Santang who had fought with Lin Hao half a year ago. He clenched his fist and struck at Wu Feng.
Today's encounter between Zou Shanhu and Lin Hao's group was not a coincidence, but intentional. They wanted to beat up Lin Hao and Wu Feng to avenge their previous failure to seize the mining area.
When fights occur in the area where the handyman disciples fight, as long as it doesn't get too serious, the outer disciples who guard the mine always turn a blind eye.
Moreover, the place where they stopped Lin Hao and the two was deliberately chosen where the outer disciples were not present.
"Phew!"
Mo Santang, who was at the second level of Qi Refining, punched him and created a fist wind.
Wu Feng took the demon pill and his cultivation was close to the second level of Qi Refining. He reacted quickly and punched to meet the attack.
"Touch!"
The two fists touched each other.
Mo Santang's expression suddenly changed. Unexpectedly, Wu Feng, who was originally weaker than him, could punch with much more power than him. A powerful force hit him, and he took several steps back before he could barely stabilize his body.
The conflict here has attracted many handyman disciples from other mining areas to watch the fun. Zou Shanhu's eyes showed a cruel look, and the villain was the first to complain and shouted: "Wu Feng, Lin Hao, you two bastards dare to hit someone, let's all come together and teach him a lesson."
"You surnamed Zou are despicable."
Lin Hao's face darkened. It was obviously their side who made the first move, while Wu Feng just passively accepted the move.
"Hmph, Lin Hao, you bitch, I've wanted to beat you for a long time."
Half a year ago, Zou Shanhu and the others failed in their land grab because of the variable Lin Hao. Therefore, Zou Shanhu hated Lin Hao the most among the four.
He jumped up, rushed towards Lin Hao quickly, raised his hand and slapped Lin Hao in the face.
Moreover, the other two handyman disciples of the second level of Qi Refining, who were with Zou Shanhu, also started to take action, and even asked the three of them to besiege Lin Hao alone.
"Junior Brother Lin, there are many of them. A good man will not suffer the immediate consequences. Let's go first."
Wu Feng took a step forward and shouted while answering Lin Hao.
"Well, good!"
